h1: Custom 64 Inches Umbrellas for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 64 inches umbrellas in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for corporate gifts, events, and brand visibility. Get a quote today!
introHtml: 64-inch umbrellas offer extra coverage for teams working outdoors, event staff, or promotional giveaways where weather protection is key. Unlike standard compact umbrellas, this larger canopy keeps two people dry and provides a generous surface for your logo or message. Choose from automatic open or manual stick styles, with options like the Steal Umbrella or The Winchester for a rugged, professional look. Durable nylon or pongee fabric ensures long-lasting use.
heroAltText: Large custom 64 inches umbrellas with corporate logo, perfect for outdoor events and promotional giveaways.
